claims: As of late April 1, 2026, the Artemis II Orion capsule is in high Earth orbit.
The Artemis II Orion capsule had a successful 6:35 p.m. ET launch from Kennedy Space Center.
The Artemis II crew has separated from the ICPS upper stage.
The Artemis II crew is conducting systems tests.
The Artemis II crew is preparing for a maneuver to send them toward the Moon.
The Artemis II crew consists of Wiseman, Glover, Koch, Hansen.
The Artemis II crew has completed a perigee raise to lift their orbit's lowest point.
The Artemis II Orion capsule will perform a Trans-Lunar Injection (TLI) burn to set a course for the Moon.
The Artemis II mission is a 10-day, nine-and-a-half-day journey around the Moon and back.
The Artemis II crew is reportedly doing well.
Artemis II is the first crewed flight of the Artemis program.
Artemis II is designed to test all systems required for future Moon landings.
